short_description: A single-leg squat with your rear foot elevated that targets the quads, glutes and hip flexors.
how_to: Stand about two feet in front of a bench or step.
Place your rear foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your hips until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down on your working foot.
Keep your torso upright throughout.
Control the descent steadily.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't lean too far forward.
Don't let your front heel lift.

short_description: A quadruped hip abduction that strengthens the glutes and outer hips.
how_to: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keep your knee bent and lift one leg out to the side.
Raise until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Lower back down with control.
Repeat on the same side, then switch.
correct: Keep your hips level throughout.
Keep your core engaged.
Move only at the hip joint.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't rotate your hips to lift higher.
Don't rush the movement.
Don't let your supporting arm buckle.
Don't raise your leg above hip height.

short_description: A prone glute exercise with the feet turned out that isolates the glutes through a short range of motion.
how_to: Lie face down and bend your knees, pressing the soles of your feet together.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Squeeze your glutes and lift both knees slightly off the floor.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower with control.
Repeat for the desired reps.
correct: Keep your glutes squeezed at the top.
Keep your lower back relaxed.
Move with control on both the lift and the lower.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't lift too high and strain your back.
Don't hold your breath.
Don't rush the repetitions.
Don't use momentum instead of muscle.

short_description: A lateral lunge that works the inner thighs, quads and glutes through a side-to-side movement.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step wide to one side and bend that knee, pushing your hips back.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return to the start.
Alternate sides with each rep.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down throughout.
Keep your chest up as you lower.
Land with control each time.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't round your lower back.
Don't let your heel lift off the floor.

short_description: A floor-based pushing exercise that targets the triceps using your bodyweight.
how_to: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and hands behind you, fingers pointing forward.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor.
Press back up to the start position.
Keep your hips off the floor throughout the set.
correct: Keep your body straight.
Keep your elbows controlled and pointing back.
Keep your core engaged.
Move at a steady pace.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop to the floor between reps.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't hunch your shoulders.
Don't lock your elbows at the top.

short_description: An isometric hold against a wall that builds endurance in the quads and glutes.
how_to: Stand with your back flat against a wall.
Walk your feet forward and slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees directly above your ankles.
Hold the position and breathe steadily.
Push into the wall with your back throughout the hold.
correct: Keep your back flat on the wall.
Keep your knees over your ankles.
Keep your thighs parallel to the floor.
Breathe steadily throughout.
mistakes: Don't let your knees drift past your toes.
Don't slide too low and strain your knees.
Don't push off your thighs with your hands.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A push-up variation that combines chest and tricep work with a hip flexor stretch by bringing the knee to the elbow.
how_to: Start in a high push-up position.
As you lower your chest toward the floor, bring one knee toward your elbow on the same side.
Press back up and return the foot to the start.
Alternate sides with each rep.
Move the knee and the push-up at the same time.
correct: Keep your body straight between reps.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way down.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
Move the knee fully to the elbow each rep.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't rush and lose form.
Don't let your lower back sag mid-rep.

short_description: A push-up followed by a thoracic rotation that builds chest and shoulder strength while opening the upper back.
how_to: Start in a high push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor with control.
Press back up, then rotate to one side, extending that arm toward the ceiling.
Return to the centre and repeat, rotating to the other side next time.
Keep your hips level during the rotation.
correct: Keep your body straight during the push-up phase.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way down.
Rotate from your upper back, not your hips.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't swing your arm to rotate.
Don't rush between the push-up and the twist.

short_description: A push-up with hands elevated on a surface that reduces load and emphasises the lower chest.
how_to: Place your hands on an elevated surface such as a bench or step, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back into a straight-body position.
Lower your chest toward the surface.
Press back up to the start.
Keep your body in a straight line throughout.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way down.
Keep your core engaged.
Lower all the way until your chest nearly touches.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't rush the descent.
Don't let your head jut forward.

short_description: A classic stepping exercise that targets the quads, glutes and hamstrings through a forward stride.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stop before the back knee touches down.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate legs with each rep.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down on your front foot.
Keep your torso upright.
Step forward with control.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't drop too fast.
Don't let your front knee shoot past your toes.
Don't lean heavily forward.
